A car has a mass of 1500kg. A constant resultant force acts on the car and the car accelerates
from 15m/s to 20m/s in 4.0 seconds.
What is the magnitude of the resultant force acting on the car?
A
300N
B
1200N
C
1900N
D
7500N
subject: Physics
